name: arxiv daily-harvest + contact-ID + ontology-relevance ranking pipeline
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-23 (to CRO). A daily scraping/harvest pipeline over arxiv.org Computer Science papers, deterministically identifying, parsing, and RANKING new papers by their relevance to Opal's ontology + graph engineering (the infra/system vocabulary + Andrew's interest anchors: retrieval, agentic engineering, graph engineering, infrastructure, harness engineering, learning-loop design patterns). Runs as a LAMBDA in Opal's cloud (the only place arxiv egress happens; STANDING arxiv-scoped daily-egress grant, cloud-only, NOT a blanket vendor lift) on a daily EventBridge schedule. Output: a DDB columnar store (metadata + scores) + an attached S3 bucket (full papers: html/pdf/tarball/extracted text), linked by a stable taxonomy aligned to the columnar form. Harvest backbone = arxiv OAI-PMH (exhaustive daily-delta by from/until window) + an Atom-API keyword overlay; categories cs.AI/cs.LG/cs.SE/cs.IR/cs.DC/cs.DB/cs.MA. Ranking = RRF(BM25, potion-base-8M) over FULL TEXT vs a versioned ontology profile; derived_state_rank = recency_decay(submission-date) x nlp_score, RECOMPUTED daily for the whole corpus as time elapses. LOSSLESS: append-only, dedup by (arxiv_id, version), never delete, watermark advances only on a complete window. Contact-ID: author names/ids from OAI metadata; emails/affiliations parsed from full text. CONVERGES with infra/system/ontology/CONTENT_MODULE_DESIGN (RRF/BM25/Potion, materialized substrate, deterministic-pinned, ablate-don't-fuse, decoy-null threshold) -- the external/arxiv instance of that content module, in the .tools/content/ partition, NOT a parallel NLP stack.
